dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar open-source COBOL supporting SCREEN SECTION with FOREGROUND-COLOR/BACKGROUND-COLOR and FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE; no EXEC CICS/SQL, no IBM-specific extensions
evidence: INDEXED file with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY

purpose.domain_detail: Customer record management system - update functionality for a customer database
purpose.summary: CUSUPD is a batch/interactive program that allows a user to search for a customer record by ID or name, display the current data on a screen, accept edits, confirm changes, and rewrite the updated record to an indexed VSAM-style file (CUSTOMER.NDX). It handles soft-deleted records (CUST-DST-REC flag).

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with color attributes (FOREGROUND-COLOR, BACKGROUND-COLOR, HIGHLIGHT, REVERSE-VIDEO)
Indexed file with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY WITH DUPLICATES
REWRITE with INVALID KEY / NOT INVALID KEY
Soft-delete flag (CUST-DST-REC) checked before allowing update
No COPY statements, no CALL statements, self-contained program
verdict.notes: Programmer credit comment ('Jonathan Walker') and straightforward structure suggest a student or training exercise. The 450-CLRFLD-RTN paragraph is defined but never called (dead code). READ-TYPE logic in 500-READ-RTN uses TRANS-ID-IN but 300-CID-RTN sets CUS-ID-IN, suggesting a minor logic inconsistency typical of student work. No COMP-3 usage. Max line length exactly 72 confirms fixed format.
